description: This file defines a class 'Size' within the PhpSpreadsheet helper namespace that manages size validation and representation, including parsing size strings with units such as points, pixels, and ems.

classes.name: Size
classes.description: A helper class for handling size strings with units, validating them, and providing access to size components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Size object, validating and parsing the input size string.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns whether the size string is valid.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the numeric size component as a string.

methods.name: unit
methods.description: Returns the unit component ('pt', 'px', 'em') as a string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the full size string combining size and unit.
